description: Comptage vélo - Données compteurs - Anglet is a series of datasets listed in Anglet Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville d'Anglet. Ce jeu de données liste les comptages horaires de vélos par compteur et localisation de sites de comptage en 2019. Un site de comptage peut être équipé d'un compteur dans le cas d'un aménagement cyclable unidirectionnel ou de deux compteurs dans le cas d'un aménagement cyclable bi-directionnel. Coverage: Anglet. The portal lists 7 near-identical datasets in this series (one per month, area, counter or year), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Mobilité, Espace Public. Its keywords are compteur, comptage, vélo, deux roues, mobilité douce, site. The portal shows 26,280 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-anglet-opendatapaysbasque-portal.
